Nicole and Mike, two friends who really, really want to play with the same big gumball machine toy. Uh-oh! They both grab it at the same time and oh no! The toy breaks into two pieces. 😢 Nicole and Mike each take a piece, but it's just not the same. They can't play ball pit and it's not working.

But here comes Uncle to save the day! 🦸‍♂️ He has a great idea. He tells the children that if they agree to share the toy, he will fix it for them. They think about it and decide to give it a try. Yay! Uncle fixes the toy, and now Nicole and Mike can play together with the whole gumball machine. 🎉 Uncle reminds them, “Kids, sharing is caring, no more fighting, ok!!!”

Nicole and Mike learn a valuable lesson about sharing and working together. They find out that when they share, they both get to have fun, and their toys don’t get broken. Remember kids, sharing is always caring! 💖
